query:
SELECT id, name FROM molecules 
WHERE name IN ('Guaiacol', 'Pyrazine', 'Furfural', 'Cresol', 'Skatole', 'Calone 1951', 'Linalool', 'Limonène', 'α-Pinène', 'Menthol', 'Myrcène', 'β-Caryophyllène', 'Humulène', 'Géosmine', 'Vetiver', 'Ambrox Super', 'Iso E Super')
OR name LIKE '%Geosmin%'
OR name LIKE '%Vetiver%'
OR name LIKE '%Ambrox%'
OR name LIKE '%Linalool%'
OR name LIKE '%Myrcene%'
OR name LIKE '%Limonene%'
OR name LIKE '%Caryophyllene%'
OR name LIKE '%Humulene%'
OR name LIKE '%Pinene%'
ORDER BY name;
